title: Softmax + Cross-Entropy (Fused) + Gradient
description:
Implement **Fused Softmax Cross-Entropy Loss** and its gradient with respect to input logits $Z$.

Given logits $Z \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times C}$ and one-hot ground truth labels $Y \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times C}$, compute cross-entropy loss stably using the log-sum-exp trick, and return the simplified analytic gradient $\frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial Z} = \frac{1}{N} (P - Y)$ where $P = \text{softmax}(Z)$.

$$
\mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}} = -\sum_{i} y_i \log \hat{y}_i, \quad \nabla_z \mathcal{L} = \hat{y} - y

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Vectorized, mathematically sound implementation.

### ⚡ Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def softmax(x):
    """
    Compute numerically stable softmax.
    """
    x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    shift_x = x_arr - np.max(x_arr, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    exps = np.exp(shift_x)
    probs = exps / np.sum(exps, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return np.round(probs, 4).tolist()
```

### ⏱️ Complexity Analysis
- **Time Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N)$
- **Space Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N)$
